subject: Re: Contract conversion — retainer -> committed credits (pricing & SLA cadence)
messages:
From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@helixhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelixHealth Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Converting our retainer to committed credits — initial ask

Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We're running this through procurement and leadership now and there is internal appetite to convert our current monthly retainer into a 12-month committed credits contract if we can get clarity on two things: (1) a visible price hold for 12 months, and (2) a safety net if usage spikes beyond the committed quantity (we need an overage trigger and rate).

High level ask from our side: 20% discount on list for a 12-month commit of the next 6M tokens, plus an SLA credit if average 95th p95 latency exceeds 300ms in production. Procurement also asked for a simple SOW and payment cadence (they prefer net 45).

Can you outline how Redwood would structure a conversion and what tradeoffs on discount / overage you can offer?

— Amir
Head of Platform, HelixHealth


From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converting our retainer to committed credits — initial ask

Amir — thanks for the clarity; appreciate the priorities. Attached is a crisp proposal (HelixHealth_Rate_Proposal_v3.pdf) + a draft SOW (SOW_HelixHealth_v2.docx) that maps current usage to a tiered commit. Summary below:

- Proposal: Convert monthly retainer to a 12-month committed block of 6,000,000 generation tokens (split across four tiers).
- Economics: Base list discount of 18% for the full commit. We can increase to 22% if Helix adds a 20% annual volume acceleration clause (i.e., minimum step-up of committed tokens at month 6).
- Price hold: We will hold per-token price for 12 months for the committed block; overage pricing is at list minus 8% until the next true-up.
- SLA credit: If 95th percentile latency > 300ms for two or more weeks in a month, Helix is eligible for a 5% credit of that month’s invoice (cumulative cap 15% over the year).
- Payment cadence: Standard is net 30; we can accept net 45 for a 1.5% fee applied to each invoice or shift to net 45 with 30-day early payment credit of 0.5% per invoice — open to procurement preference.

We included a short mutual action plan in the proposal: legal redlines, final SKU mapping, and an ops review (to confirm regions and burst capacity). If this aligns, Ben can work on pricing exceptions and Marcus can sign off on the SLA language.

Next steps: Can procurement send the SOW + preferred payment terms and any required audit/KYC docs? I’ll loop in finance to confirm the net45 mechanics.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: HelixHealth_Rate_Proposal_v3.pdf; SOW_HelixHealth_v2.docx
From: HelixHealth Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amir Khan <amir.khan@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converting our retainer to committed credits — initial ask

Priya — thanks for the proposal. Procurement comments below (high priority):

1) Contract redlines: we need standard indemnity language and data residency assurances. Please send a contract redline we can review.
2) Payment: we have approval for net 45 but require an invoice schedule with milestone-based invoices (quarterly) rather than monthly. Would Redwood accept quarterly billing aligned to the committed block?
3) Overage: procurement prefers a hard per-token overage cap (no greater than 120% of committed monthly average) with a daily notification when usage crosses 90% of monthly run-rate.
4) References & SOC: Please attach SOC 2 report and a customer reference from a medtech customer.

We’ll share a procurement intake form by end of day.

— HelixHealth Procurement

On Tue, May 19, 2026 at 08:30, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Amir — thanks for the clarity; appreciate the priorities. Attached is a crisp proposal...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: internal: HelixHealth — pricing flex and approval path

Priya / Marcus — quick internal note after reviewing Helix procurement asks:

- Discount: we can stretch to 20% for the 6M commit if they accept quarterly prepay (or a 10% prepayment) and the acceleration clause at 15% step-up at month 7 instead of 20%.
- SLA credit: approved as-is (5% monthly credit, cap 15% annually) but legal wants clearer observability windows and a production runbook in the SOW.
- Overage cap: we can agree to a soft cap enforcement at 120% as long as we get alerting hooks (webhook or email) and a 3-day cooling period before forced throttling.
- Payment cadence: finance will accept quarterly billing if we get a contract amendment guaranteeing committed capacity. Otherwise stick to monthly billing.

Action items I can take: generate the contract redline (I’ll use redlines_contract_helix.pdf), and model two invoice schedules (monthly vs quarterly). Marcus — need your sign-off on the 20% discount threshold for finance to approve the net 45 plus quarterly invoices.

— Ben
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@helixhealth.com>, HelixHealth Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converting our retainer to committed credits — proposal & MAP

Amir / Procurement — circling back with an updated position and a short MAP to keep momentum.

What Redwood can commit to now (summary):
- 6,000,000 token 12-month commit with a 20% off-list discount if Helix signs the attached amendment by June 4.
- Quarterly invoicing accepted if Helix agrees to a minimum quarterly prepay equal to 25% of the committed annual block (remits at start of quarter).
- Price hold for the committed block for 12 months. Overage pricing: list minus 8% up to 120% monthly run-rate; we will send webhook alerts at 85% and 95%.
- SLA credit: 5% monthly credit after validated p95 > 300ms for two separate weeks in the month; capped at 15% for the year. Runbook section added to SOW (see SOW_HelixHealth_v2.docx).
- Legal redlines attached: redlines_contract_helix.pdf. We included indemnity language and a data residency clause aligned to our standard private deployment model (we can scope region-specific language during legal review).

Mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Procurement returns signed procurement intake + preferred invoice schedule by May 27.
2) Internal ops review to validate burst capacity needs (Redwood ops — target May 28).
3) Legal exchange redlines and final doc signing (target June 1).

Please confirm acceptance of the 25% quarterly prepay or we will provide the monthly invoice model with a 10% prepay instead. Once we have agreement on billing cadence I will send a DocuSign package and the final amendment (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/HELIX-HLX-2026-034).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps move things faster.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
